## Getting data into R - Official Solutions ::: {.callout-note} ### Instructor Note Add your specific DCC lab answers below this box. ::: ### Task 1: Downloading the Dataset Students were required to download the `lbw.csv` dataset. Success in this task is confirmed by the file appearing in the project directory. ### Task 2: Importing the Data To import the data correctly using the Tidyverse, the `library(tidyverse)` must be called first.
